chunks: It would be but a single blast of the trumpet, and they would all be arraigned before Us.
ai.seo_question: How quickly will the resurrection occur according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the absolute power of God's command, where a single 'Sahqa' (blast) instantly gathers all creation, underscoring the ease with which the Divine can resurrect the dead. It serves as a profound reminder of the immediacy of the Hour, contrasting the brevity of the call with the eternal accountability that follows before the Creator.
